text:
lina: Quick design check-in for the private setup preflight UI. I want a denser final summary that: - doesn't force users to scroll past verbose probe logs, - clearly surfaces next actions when checks fail, and - is friendly to keyboard/screen-reader users. Thoughts?

matt: Agree on denser summary. Proposal: single summary card with status pill, short phrase line, and a chevron to expand probe list. When collapsed show counts and final CTA if anything failed.

devon: Implementation notes: when collapsed we only render lightweight metadata. Expand should lazy-load the full probe rows to speed initial render. Keyboard behavior: chevron is a button with aria-expanded; when expanded focus moves to the first probe row. Esc collapses and returns focus to the chevron.

samira: Accessibility: use a polite aria-live region for incremental updates: e.g. "Network probe progress: 1 of 4 checks complete." On final state announce: "Network probe complete: 4 passed" or "Network probe complete: 3 passed, 1 failed". Ensure aria-labels for pill status and use text equivalents for icons.

lina: Copy ideas: Running: "Running connection checks (2/4)" Success: "Connection checks completed All reachable." Partial: "Connection checks completed  3 passed, 1 failed. Expand for fixes." Keep CTAs explicit: "Retry failed checks" vs just "Retry".

matt: UX nit: Make docs links subtle (text link under secondary actions). Primary action should only appear when user can act (Retry or Contact support). Also consider an inline 'copy diagnostic' tiny button when expanded.

devon: Backend signal: emit per-probe summary events so UI can update counts without polling. Also include remediation hints in the event payload so we can show short one-line fixes in the expanded rows.

samira: Contrast check: the small status pill uses color plus text; ensure contrast ratio meets AA for the text. For the spinner inside the pill, add aria-hidden and visible text for screen reader.

ci-bot: build-preview for pr/4227 ready at https://deploy.preview/redwood/panel/4227

matt: I'll ship a compact mock with motion and collapsed state this afternoon. Samira, can you run keyboard + NVDA pass after I upload?

samira: Yep, I'll test keyboard focus order, aria-live announcements, and ensure the expanded probe list is navigable.

lina: Action items: Matt produce mock (EOD), Devon add aria hooks + lazy-load rows, Samira accessibility pass, I'll book a 20-min signoff tomorrow. Thanks! :rocket:
